//: Everything Ask AI can point at in Simple mode. Ask AI's 'Show me' steps name an id; the app moves to its tab (or opens the report, folder or dialog it needs), finds the element and spotlights it. 'selector' defaults to [data-spot="<id>"]. 'item' says what the step's item names: 'match' means the element itself carries data-spot-item (a card or row); 'report', 'folder' and 'kit-review' mean the app opens that report, folder or the asset dialog for that report first. 'open' expands a collapsed section.
